newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: HLG Capital to buy investment firm stake.
newsitem.headline: HLG Capital to buy investment firm stake.

text.p: Malaysian stockbroker HLG Capital Bhd said on Friday it has entered into an agreement with Guoco Securities (Bermuda) Ltd to buy 50 percent of investment firm Growluck Ltd for eight million ringgit.
In a statement, HLG said Growluck is a company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands. Growluck holds 100 percent of Guoco Securities (Philippines) Inc, a stockbroker.
HLG also said it plans to sell its seat on the Philippine Stock Exchange upon completion of the proposed acquisition.

The proposed acquisition forms part of HLG's plan to expand regionally and further enhances its stockbroking business, the statement said. The purchase will also create synergies with HLG Capital (Philippines) Inc, HLG's investment arm in that country, it said.

HLG said it has proposed to sell its Philippines Stock Exchange seat to Unicapital Securities Inc for 74 million pesos. It said the disposal would allow it to channel its resources towards developing Guoco Securities Philippines.
